summary: Phase.shipped returns the tags its span ships out of the work entry and its steps; an empty list is not-shipped and a partial list leaves the work entry queued with the steps that remain

per.section: Ship detection trusts the agent's own account

acceptance: an undeclared shipped ships the work entry and every step; an empty return records not-shipped exactly as the boolean false did; a partial return removes the named steps' files and leaves the work entry queued
tests: an undeclared shipped ships the work entry and every one of its steps
a shipped returning an empty list records the entry not-shipped
a shipped naming some of an entry's steps removes those files and leaves the work entry queued
the package's shipped returns no tag for a commit that put its work down
notes: Pre-1.0: the boolean is edited out, not kept beside the list. How a build session says which steps it finished is not stated for the package — see the questions directory; the package's own `shipped` stays all-or-nothing here.
